name: Club del Miniautodromo (Mini Autodromo di Massa)
evidence: Nominatim places this kart complex (two raceways plus multipolygon relation 19265153) in Turano, Massa; a forum listing names the outdoor 'Mini Autodromo di Massa' at Loc. Turano and Yumping lists Club del Miniautodromo in Massa selling 1-hour GP / mini-GP kart races to the public. The listed address (Via Aurelia Sud 112) was not verified on a map. Rental left unverified: sources are a forum post and a directory listing only.
